whatItIs: NaturesMud Carrot Powder is cold-milled from 100% sweet, orange Nepali carrots harvested at peak winter maturity. Nearly 900g of washed carrots are sliced, gently dehydrated below 45°C to protect natural beta-carotene (pro-vitamin A) and lutein, and ground into a bright orange powder—with 0% added sugar, 0% starch fillers, and 0% artificial color.
nepaliKitchenUses: Baby Weaning Jaulo & Lito (6M+): Stir 1 teaspoon (5g) into simmering rice jaulo, mung dal soup, or suji porridge with a drop of ghee/coconut oil so fat-soluble beta-carotene absorbs well (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).
Golden-Orange Chapati & Paratha: Knead 1 tablespoon into whole-wheat atta to make soft, beta-carotene-rich orange rotis for school tiffin.
Quick Carrot Soup & Dal Thickener: Whisk 1 tablespoon into vegetable soup, thukpa broth, or yellow dal.
Instant Gajar Halwa & Kheer Boost: Add 2 tablespoons to simmering milk with Dates Powder and cardamom for a quick carrot milk/kheer.
whoItSuits: Ideal for infants starting weaning meals (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician), picky-eater toddlers who refuse cooked vegetable pieces, students, and busy home cooks.
monsoonStorage: Natural carrot sugars absorb humidity if left open. Keep the glass jar lid tightly closed in a dark cupboard away from sunlight and stove steam, and always use a dry spoon.

faqs.q: Can I give Carrot Powder to my 6-month-old baby?
faqs.a: Yes! It is 100% single-ingredient carrot with 0 salt, 0 sugar, and 0 preservatives. Cook 1/2 to 1 teaspoon in baby jaulo, lito, or dal soup for 2 minutes (suitable from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).

faqs.q: Why should I add a drop of ghee or coconut oil when cooking Carrot Powder?
faqs.a: Carrots are rich in beta-carotene (pro-vitamin A), which is a fat-soluble nutrient. Cooking with a tiny drop of ghee or Virgin Coconut Oil helps the body absorb beta-carotene effectively.

faqs.q: How many fresh carrots go into one 100 GM jar?
faqs.a: Fresh carrots are ~88% water, so roughly 850g to 900g of fresh Nepali carrots are dehydrated and milled to fill a single 100 GM jar.

faqs.q: Does it contain any salt, sugar, or cornstarch?
faqs.a: No—0% salt, 0% added sugar, and 0% starch fillers.
